about: Phase 7 hand review of every textbook verse block (4+ lines) that lies in one poet's chapter, follows a lead-in ending in «:», and passes the automatic guards but is not yet published. Each lead-in was read. Four rounds: the second followed a fix to poet-name matching (a rejected record «Дар» had made the other-poet guard fire on most lead-ins), the third and fourth fixes to where blocks end. Accepted blocks are published by tool/literature/publish_reviewed_blocks.py; blocks already published or overlapping a published poem are skipped there.
